- Alternative 2: Maximum number of scale intervals = 6000; P_ind = 0.50

This looks like two configurations/alternatives of the indicators. The 820i has 10,000 scale intervals and 920i has 6,000? Actually the real certificate: Rice Lake 820i (10,000 intervals, P_ind=0.75?) and 920i... Actually I shouldn't fabricate. The markdown doesn't explicitly say Alternative 1 = 820i and Alternative 2 = 920i. So I should treat alternatives as configuration axes.

So model_family: models 820i and 920i (both are certified types — "820i and 920i indicating devices"). The alternatives are configurations. I'll use config_level for the attributes that vary by alternative.
